takeaway: Type IV (delayed) hypersensitivity is cell-mediated, not antibody-mediated: CD4+ Th1 helper T cells recognise antigen with MHC class II. Examples: Mantoux test, chronic transplant rejection.

lines.text: Type Four hypersensitivity is delayed: it takes several days to develop.
Unlike the other types, it is not antibody mediated. It is a cell-mediated response.
So the mediator is the helper T cell.
CD4+ Th1 helper T cells recognise antigen in a complex with MHC class two, on antigen-presenting cells.
